name: Somnivrel
description: Somnivrel is a precision neuromodulator that optimizes REM/NREM cycling ratios across the sleep period, ensuring maximum restorative yield from both stages and preventing the REM suppression commonly caused by BCI activity, stimulant use, or chronic stress. Unlike blunter sleep aids, Somnivrel works with the brain's natural sleep architecture rather than replacing it, correcting dysregulated patterns over a course of use.
effects: Enhanced memory consolidation and emotional processing
Counteracts REM suppression from BCI overstimulation
Improved cognitive performance and emotional regulation upon waking
Cumulative benefit with regular use — sleep quality improves progressively over weeks
side_effects: Vivid, emotionally intense dreams as suppressed REM content is restored — overwhelming for first-time users
Mild nausea if taken without food
Occasional sleep-talking or movement during enhanced REM phases
Interacts poorly with Dormacet — combined use can destabilize cycling entirely
duration: Active during full sleep cycle, 7-9 hours
street_price: Φ22 per capsule, Φ160 for 8-dose course
cultural_context: Somnivrel occupies the respectable, almost mundane end of the sleep-drug market — it's what doctors prescribe when they want to help someone sleep better without the risks of harder compounds. Tier 2 workers who've been running on poor sleep for years often go through a course of Somnivrel and describe it as 'like getting a new brain.' The restored REM content, however, means that years of emotionally suppressed dream material surfaces in the first week — which can be genuinely destabilizing.
story_hooks: A Tier 2 factory worker starts a Somnivrel course and begins experiencing dreams so vivid and coherent they appear to be someone else's memories — possibly from an SNT implant they received that carried residual neural data from its previous host.

Novafold is running a quiet longitudinal study: users who complete the 8-dose Somnivrel course are being monitored for whether improved sleep quality affects their political engagement and consumer behavior — and the results are being sold to Tier 5 campaign architects.

A Shelf medic has been distributing stolen Somnivrel to chrome-rejection patients who can't afford the prescription, with remarkable results — until Novafold's enforcement arm takes notice and the medic needs help staying alive.
